name: quizdeck
description: Offline-first quiz practice with reviewed AI-assisted question classification.

scripts.build:mobile: pnpm run clean:mobile-output && vite build --config vite.mobile.config.ts
scripts.android:sync: pnpm run build:mobile && pnpm run clean:android-assets && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:assembleZhDebug :app:assembleEnDebug
scripts.android:apk:zh: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:assembleZhDebug
scripts.android:apk:en: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:assembleEnDebug
scripts.verify: pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build:mobile
